description: This PHP source file defines the SuiteBeanResource class, which handles conversion between SugarBean objects and JSON API resource representations, including managing attributes, relationships, and file uploads within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: SuiteBeanResource
classes.description: A resource class for converting SugarBean objects to and from JSON API representations, managing attributes, relationships, and file uploads within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: fromSugarBean
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean object into a SuiteBeanResource, including attributes, relationships, and links.

methods.name: toSugarBean
methods.description: Converts the SuiteBeanResource back into a SugarBean object, updating fields, handling relationships, and saving files.

methods.name: fromJsonApiRequest
methods.description: Creates a SuiteBeanResource from a JSON API request array.

methods.name: fromResource
methods.description: Copies data from a Resource object into a SuiteBeanResource.

methods.name: withRelationship
methods.description: Associates a Relationship object with this resource.

methods.name: retrieveFileFromBean
methods.description: Retrieves a file from a SugarBean and encodes it as a base64 string in attributes.

methods.name: saveFileToBean
methods.description: Saves a base64-encoded file from attributes into a SugarBean, creating revisions if necessary.
